# monero_wallet_ui — Monero Wallet

> The Monero wallet: balances, a reviewed send, receive addresses with a QR, activity, and the wallet management (create, restore, open, close, change password, show seed) every Monero wallet keeps in the same app. The password crosses as a SLOT argument only, never as a property.

## App-to-app intents

- provides `{'intent': 'monero.wallet.unlock', 'params': [{'name': 'wallet', 'type': 'string', 'required': True, 'description': "The backend registry's name for the wallet to open"}]}`
- provides `{'intent': 'monero.accounts.manage', 'handoff': True}`
- uses `{'intent': 'monero.node.configure', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
